name: Moodz Candle Set
description: Save and buy all 3! Moodz are made using a special production process combining different colors of wax into a single candle. The candles are molded and then polished to create a glossy finish. The use of palm wax gives them a very long life compared to soy or paraffin candles of the same size.

name: Tarot Candle Duo: The Lovers & Death
description: Two Tarot candles. Two powerful readings. One transformative experience. The Love & Death Tarot Candle Duo brings together The Lovers and Death cards in a beautifully scented pairing designed to spark connection, reflection, and change. The Lovers represents attraction, passion, and meaningful choices, while Death symbolizes transformation, release, and new beginnings. Each candle combines original Tarot artwork, an illuminating reading, and a fragrance crafted to match the energy of the card. The Lovers features notes of Blood Orange, Wild Moss & Embers.Death features Tobacco Flower, Orange Peel & Leather. Light them together or separately depending on the energy you want to invite in.

name: Buon Appetito Baguette
description: This realistic baguette-shaped candle is a delightful addition to any space. Warning: It might look realistic, but burn it, don't eat it! Made in Italy.

name: Tarot Candle Duo: The Hermit and The Fool
description: A balance of bold beginnings and quiet reflection. The Adventure & Reflection Tarot Candle Duo pairs The Fool and The Hermit, bringing together two powerful energies for life’s journey. The Fool invites spontaneity, fresh starts, and fearless forward movement, while The Hermit encourages stillness, introspection, and reconnecting with your inner wisdom. Each candle combines original Tarot artwork, an illuminating reading, and a fragrance designed to reflect the energy of the card. Whether you are stepping into something new or taking time to pause and reflect, this duo is made to guide the moment. The Hermit features notes of Blood Orange, Wild Moss & Embers.The Fool features Tobacco Flower, Orange Peel & Leather.

name: Tarot Candle Duo: The Magician & The High Priestess
description: Where intuition meets action, magic happens. The Intuition & Manifestation Tarot Candle Duo brings together The High Priestess and The Magician, pairing inner wisdom with focused action. The High Priestess invites you to trust your intuition, embrace your power, and let things unfold in their own time. The Magician channels confidence, determination, and the energy to turn ideas into reality. Each candle combines original Tarot artwork, an illuminating reading, and a fragrance crafted to reflect the spirit of the card. The High Priestess features notes of Pomegranate, Red Berries & Patchouli.The Magician features Bergamot, Eucalyptus & Cedar. Light this duo when setting intentions, seeking clarity, or creating your next chapter.
